en.title: Netherlands Recovers 86 Tons of Gold Stored in US and Canada
en.hook: Netherlands brings back 86 tons of gold held abroad, boosting national financial sovereignty
key_takeaways: Netherlands reclaimed 86 tons of gold stored in the United States and Canada
The move enhances national economic security and reduces reliance on foreign vaults
It marks a significant shift toward repatriating overseas assets for greater fiscal stability

这一举措增强了国家经济安全，减少了对外国金库的依赖
标志着将海外资产收回国内，以实现更大财政稳定
